verifiedFailureBoundary: GL4ES ordinary provider admission withholds GL_EXT_texture_array because its cached ESSL 300 probe compiles malformed source

structuralCause.defect: testGLSL concatenates the version token directly with a malformed extension directive, so testGLSL("#version 300 es", 0) cannot establish hardext.glsl300es
structuralCause.effect: BuildExtensionsList short-circuits before gl4es_texture_array_available and omits GL_EXT_texture_array; the engine therefore never queries the wrapper layer limit and reports zero
structuralCause.correction: use one complete stage-correct ESSL 300 vertex source for the live compile probe and expose only the cached provider result through a read-only embedder snapshot
